lines.en: Patched hide, walking the plains.
Nose to the ground, sniffing as I go.
These patches are born with me.
Four short hooves, quick on the run.
Rooting through the plains grass.
I trot with a bounce.
My snout turns the soil.

lines.zh: 这身斑纹看着乱，其实好用
lines.en: The patches look random, but they work.
Hunting roots underground.
Waddling along, tail swinging.

lines.zh: 平原上没什么能绊倒我
lines.en: Nothing on the plains trips me.
Done with this patch; on to the next.
Not fast, but never stopping.
My snout is my best tool.

lines.zh: 这身花斑在草里很隐蔽
lines.en: These patches blend into the grass.

lines.zh: 我一路上留下翻开的土
lines.en: I leave turned soil behind me.
Standing still, my snout still works.
Two grunts; content.

lines.zh: 平原的太阳晒得背上暖
lines.en: The plains sun warms my back.
These mottles make me easy to know.

lines.zh: 我在等土里的东西冒头
lines.en: Waiting for something to surface.
Tail swishing off the flies.
The holes I rooted aren't filled yet.
Pigs like clean spots too.
This soil smells good.
I settle down for a rest.

lines.zh: 隔着坡，有猪在应我的哼声。
lines.en: Across the slope, a pig answers my grunt.
My hide looks pieced together.
Dried mud itches on my skin.
Two more rootings, then back.
The wind through grass reaches me.
Round belly; life's good.

lines.zh: 你攥在手里的，是给我的吗。
lines.en: That fistful you're holding — is it for me?
You're blocking my light.
I tilt my head; my snout moves first.
You smell of carrots.

lines.zh: 我这身花斑，吓到你没有
lines.en: Do these patches startle you?

lines.zh: 你看我，我看你手里的东西
lines.en: You look at me; I look at your hands.
A grunt is my hello.
Strangers are rare on the plains.

lines.zh: 你要是不动，我就过去拱你
lines.en: If you don't move, I'll root at you.

lines.zh: 我拱土的时候别站太近
lines.en: Don't stand close while I root.
Those boots look sturdy.
Don't wave that at me.
Grunt! That really hurt.
Even this flesh fears pain.
I back off, snout still wrinkled.
Something got through the thick hide.
My grunt came out loud.
My hooves went weak.
This wound won't stop my rooting.
Whoever hit me, I'll remember.
Blood in the mud smells wrong.
Head down, breathing hard.
Carrots? I know that smell.
I'll follow, as far as needed.

lines.zh: 你手抖一下，我就冲过去
lines.en: Shake your hand and I'll charge.
Scatter it; I'll root for it.
That one's too small.

lines.zh: 闭着眼我也能闻到胡萝卜。
lines.en: Even with my eyes shut I smell a carrot.

lines.zh: 土里的甜味，我一闻就知道
lines.en: I smell sweetness in the soil at once.
Don't run; I can catch you.
More; I'm not full.
My snout's all mud from rooting.
Smells freshly dug.
Lower it; I can reach.

lines.zh: 我拱土的劲都用在追你了
lines.en: All my rooting strength goes into chasing you.

lines.zh: 这味道让我鼻子抽个不停
lines.en: The smell keeps my snout twitching.
Following food is no shame.

lines.zh: 你走前面带我，我跟得紧
lines.en: Lead the way; I'm right behind.
Bumping me is like hitting a dirt mound.
Move; this weight doesn't stop easily.
My snout bumped your leg.
This meat is solid.

lines.zh: 你的靴跟压住了我的蹄尖。
lines.en: Your heel is pinning the tip of my hoof.
One bump and we both sway.
No obstacles on the plains but you.

lines.zh: 我拱着拱着就到你脚边
lines.en: Rooting along, I reached your feet.
Don't block my foraging path.
This bulk turns slowly; don't rush me.
These patches run in my family.
Two pigs rooting together, lively.
The plains soil is enough for us both.
Your nose is sharp too.
Let's hunt roots together.
One grunt, and it's settled.
The mud wallow is big enough for two.
Our piglets will have patches too.
You lead; I'll root behind you.
We'll turn this field by turns.
A root on the ground.
One push of my snout and it's out.
I carry it, chewing as I walk.
Don't grab; I rooted it first.
Whatever drops, I can eat.
That sweetness in the dirt was worth it.
What's in my mouth beats what's on the ground.
Holding it, swallowing slowly.
One's enough.
What I turn up is mine.
You're after my food.
A pig can charge when riled.
Snout down means I'm charging.
This bulk presses heavy.
Don't think pigs are easy prey.
My hooves are scraping.
This one's a root at you.
You stepped on my food.
No retreat on open plains.
I warn once.
I fix on you, snout still working.
You step, I root forward.

lines.zh: 蹄子刨出的土堆起来了
lines.en: My hooves are piling up dirt.
My grunt turned rough.
Pigs hold grudges.
Hiding in the grass won't help.
Head low, tusks showing.
One step closer and I charge.
I smell your fear.
This plain is mine to root.
One charge sends you back several steps.
My snout rams your waist.
Short tusks still cut.
This weight hurts on impact.
Two charges in a row.
Rooted right over, weren't you?
And my hoof came down.
Don't stand in front of me.
This is for that carrot.

lines.zh: 我打得不好看，但很实在
lines.en: Not pretty, but it lands.
My snout turns the soil first.
A patchy hide joins the plains.
One grunt, and I'm steady.
This ground smells good.
The grass parts and I root my way out.
All four hooves planted.
I'm here; food first.
A clod of earth turned over.
These patches are unmistakable.
The plains wind carries earth smell.

lines.zh: 皮都烤硬了，我往泥里滚
lines.en: My hide baked hard; I roll in the mud.
I fell and landed belly first.
Water up my snout; I snort it out.
The blast rolled me over.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的斑纹里
lines.en: Something stuck into my patches.
This pain didn't come from a bump.
Nothing to root up; I'm starving.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我四条腿都麻了
lines.en: Lightning struck; all four legs numb.
Nothing below, and I'm still rooting.
